annotations.text:
OPTION 1 — keep the map as Home, give recommendations a mode and a full-screen state.
Two frames: the segmented sheet on "For you", and the same sheet dragged to full height.
Recommended: no new tab, no duplicate list surface, and the map keeps doing work in both states.
OPTION 2 — your other idea: Discover becomes Home, the map moves to its own tab.
Colour is still Nightfall as a placeholder — this round is about where recommendations live, not the palette. Scheme choice from the last canvas is still open.
